fields.project: id, idea, brief, audience, goal, platform, aspect, duration_s, language, mode(co-create|autonomous|template)
fields.design_spec: palette, typography, motion_tokens_id, energy_curve, styleframe_refs, data_policy
fields.shots: [{ id, from, duration_f, card_id, card_style_key, intent, action, asset_ref, caption, transition_in, transition_out, sfx_cue, beat_anchor, energy, qa_frames:[n,n], backend, props, schema, locked[], user_edited[], origin, render_status }]
fields.publish: platforms[], title, description, tags[], cover, ai_disclosure, schedule
fields.template: { schema:"cineforge/template/v1", id, name, from_project, layers[], style{}, structure{}, motion{}, sound{}, slots[] }
fields.goal: { schema:"cineforge/goal-state/v1", stage, status(running|waiting|interrupted|done|failed), waiting_for, safe_point{stage,shot_id}, completed_stages[], interrupt_requested, overrides[], last_heartbeat }

invariants: SHOTS 是唯一事实源；字幕表 / SFX 钉帧 / 转场点全部从它派生
禁 Date.now() / Math.random()，伪随机固定种子
每镜只讲一个主动效；品牌字标 hold ≥30f；批量动效收尾留 15f 静止
分镜确认前不得进入最终素材采集
locked[] 是唯一阻止 AI 覆盖的机制；user_edited[] 仅作界面标记
模板只存「怎么拍」不存「拍什么」：slots[] 必须在新建工程时由用户填写
GOAL 模式不得自动通过分镜硬门（除非 goal.overrides[] 有手写确认记录）

locked.type: string[] (JSON path segments within the shot, e.g. ["card_id","props.blur"]; ["*"] locks the whole shot)
locked.semantics: AI regeneration MUST skip locked paths. Only the user (or an explicit user action) may change or unlock them.
locked.note: user_edited[] is a visual marker only; it does NOT block AI overwrite. locked[] is the only blocking mechanism.
